# Gofer Content

> Gofer Content builds, hosts, and maintains websites for artists, makers, and small businesses in St. Petersburg, Florida. Every site is hand-coded from scratch, live in 24 hours, and set up to be found on Google and in AI answers.

## Services
- Website builds: Hand-coded sites, no templates or drag-and-drop builders
- Hosting and upkeep: Updates, forms, and security handled monthly
- Getting found: Search and AI answer setup so customers find the business
- Landing pages: Single-page sites built fast
- Games and quizzes: Daily trivia, personality quizzes, fan polls, and surveys that live on the client's own site. Example: Daily Blues, a daily blues history trivia game (https://gofercontent.com/games/daily-blues/). Live on client sites: the Florida Word Search (https://www.omgitswicks.com/games/word-search) and Wicks Coloring Pages (https://www.omgitswicks.com/coloring) for OMG Its Wicks

## Main page
- [Gofer Content](https://gofercontent.com/): Services, client work, and contact form
- [Games, quizzes, and polls](https://gofercontent.com/games/): Daily trivia, fan quizzes, polls, and surveys built into client websites, with playable samples

- [JAW's Custom Wood](https://jawscustomwood.com/): Reclaimed Florida wood

- [Hip Pocket Studios](https://hippocketstudios.com/): Remote drum tracking and music
- [Janie Richards](https://janierichards.com/): Vocalist and officiant, St. Pete
- [Motel Funk](https://janierichards.com/motel-funk.html): Soul, funk, and R&B band, Tampa Bay
- [Joey Interrante](https://joeydrums.com/): Professional drummer, Tampa Bay
